description: The Universal DVB-T2 Calculator from ENENSYS helps terrestrial network implementers adjust DVB-T2 parameter sets step by step and weigh the results, since DVB-T2 (ETSI EN 302 755) offers thousands of configurations, with multi-PLP and flexible framing. It has three folders: a Waveform Shaper that defines channel bandwidth, FFT size, guard interval, pilot pattern and frame duration and shows waveform overhead and bitrate versus robustness for AWGN, fixed and portable channels compared with DVB-T; a Multiple PLP Allocator that distributes capacity across services; and a Coverage estimator. Producer: ENENSYS (France), a broadcast equipment vendor. Coverage: standard-based, applicable in any country. Access: described on the vendor page; how to obtain the tool, its price and terms are not stated there. Licence and cost: treated as on request. Caveats: the page is marketing text, gives no version number or validation, and the coverage estimator's propagation model was not documented. Simulation uses: it supplies quick capacity and coverage estimates that feed broadcast network planning models. Related records: the ITU SFN design report (data-itu-r-bt-2386-single-frequency-networks-design-report) and the propagation method P.1546 (model-itu-r-p-1546).
